chapter: British revival and the Crane River band
title: Why traditional jazz is bigger in Britain than the States
summary: Colyer thinks British trad is larger and healthier than in America, because Britain had lost its own folk culture and jazz filled the gap.

story.theme_name: Where jazz stands today: young players, rock, and the audience
